footer: Xia et al. 2016 Sci. Rep. 6:35943, Fig. 3g (CC BY 4.0; adapted) at 1.798 µm/px, with the edges of (a) the shipped opencif rc6 mask xia2016_rs7_depicted and (b) the rc6 variant xia2016_rs7_depicted_fig3 (cyan).  The side channel's width at the end is set by F (the outlet identity): the printed ~15 : 1 (F 0.938) draws 599.7 µm against the image's 624.6 µm (outline to outline); F 0.94072 (15.9 : 1) draws 624.6 µm, and D 6.5705 µm (x 0.957 of the printed f_ref's) then fills Fig. 3a's legs (code/xia_fig3_fit.py).  A reading of the figures under the model's premises, not of the text.
